rulings.verbatim: 也要放到工厂的dashboard里面，这是健康标准的一项，还要显示在总览里面。每个环节的健康标准都要添加。
rulings.intent: An open ready-for-agent issue whose units all ended moves on by itself, with no human step. A ruling (advisor or triage) after the last unit, including after a merged unit, restores it as the next slice; a unit closed by a stop-loss recut is restored once per unit. The rule never closes an issue and never routes a delivered issue to triage: no signal says whether a merged PR did the whole work, and triage would conclude it as awaiting-release. Skipped: issues under a hold (.hold), issues at CONCLUDE_RUN_ATTEMPT_CAP, external deliverables, units still owed their awaiting-release write. Head decision 2026-11-07 through the supervisor; the founder's order is the dashboard-health requirement quoted in verbatim.
